thread:
alex_corp: Hey team — our app started getting 403s when we send a single request that does generation + embeddings + rerank. Error returned: "403 Forbidden - insufficient_scope: missing 'rerank' permission". Happened around 09:12 PDT. Works if we split into separate calls with a different key. Any idea?

sam-support: Sorry about that — can you paste the exact curl you used and the full error body? Also which API key id (not the key itself) are you using?

alex_corp: Here's the curl we used:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/compose \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXXX" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"generation": {...}, "embeddings": {...}, "rerank": {...}}'
```
Error body:
```
{
  "error": {
    "message": "insufficient_scope",
    "detail": "missing scope: rerank",
    "status": 403
  }
}
```
Key id: key-78321

sam-support: Ok hold — that key looks like an SSO-provisioned user key. @aj can you check key scopes?

aj: Looking at key-78321 in the admin panel — scopes: ["generation","embeddings"]. No "rerank". That would explain the 403 when the request includes the rerank block. SSO-created tokens often don't include rerank by default.

devon: Rerank is considered a privileged scope and is not included on short-lived user/OAuth tokens. For automated pipelines you generally need a service key or an admin-set scope.

sam-support: Quick repro / fix steps:
1) Console -> API Keys -> Create service key.
2) Select scopes: generation, embeddings, rerank.
3) Replace the token in your pipeline with the new sk_service_xxx and retry.

Example retry curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/compose \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_service_xxx" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"generation": {...}, "embeddings": {...}, "rerank": {...}}'
```

alex_corp: We're on Dedicated — does that change anything? The key was provisioned by our infra team template.

aj: Dedicated keys are still scoped. Looks like your infra template omitted rerank. We recommend rotating that key. We'll also check infra templates.

deploy-bot: created temporary support key key-99999 (scoped: generation, embeddings, rerank) for testing — token redacted.

sam-support: We generated a temporary support key and shared it via the secure channel. Can you confirm if swapping to that key fixes the error?

alex_corp: Swapped in the temp key, reran the composite request — success. No 403 anymore. :white_check_mark:

aj: Root cause: provisioning template for org "alex-corp" had default scopes ["generation","embeddings"] — rerank was missing. Filed INFRA-1293 to update templates and add a check during provisioning.

devon: Security note: please avoid using user SSO keys in CI. We'll add an org policy suggestion to prevent that. Also recommended: rotate any keys that were accidentally issued with elevated privileges.

sam-support: Closing here since customer confirmed fix. Console link for keys: https://console.redwood.ai/orgs/alex-corp/keys — reach out if anything else :eyes:
